profile.headline:
Principal Software Engineer (in test) at Fidelity Investments- Fidelity Trader Plus
| Hands-on architect | AI/LLM integration | Cross-platform automation | Business-aligned leadership | Rapid enablement
profile.summary:
AI-ENHANCED TECHNICAL LEADERSHIP & AUTOMATION EXPERTISE

AI/LLM Integration & Intelligent Automation: Pioneering AI-augmented development workflows and LLM-integrated automation systems at scale. Expert in leveraging generative AI for framework architecture design, intelligent test orchestration, and accelerated team enablement. Established industry-leading best practices for AI-assisted coding, debugging, documentation, and knowledge transfer that reduce development cycles by 300% and engineer onboarding from 8 weeks to 2 weeks. Building next-generation metadata-driven systems that abstract complexity through AI-powered abstraction layers.

Enterprise Framework Architecture: Design and implement production-grade automation solutions with intelligent, metadata-driven architectures. Cross-platform expertise spanning Mobile (iOS/Android), Web, and Desktop (Windows/macOS) with YAML-based UI abstraction enabling seamless single-codebase execution across all environments. Specialized in building frameworks that empower junior developers to rapidly contribute while maintaining enterprise reliability.
Technical Proficiencies:

Languages & Frameworks: Python, JavaScript/NodeJS, Kotlin, ReactJS
Automation & Testing: Appium, Selenium, API Testing, BDD, A/B Testing
DevOps & Infrastructure: CI/CD, Jenkins, Gradle, Bitrise, PowerShell
Advanced Capabilities: Machine Learning, Real-time Telemetry & Analytics

Software Development & Product Leadership: At Fidelity Investments, architected AI-enhanced performance testing framework for Trader+ desktop platform with comprehensive observability pipeline. At VGT, Schneider Electric, and iHeartMedia, designed scalable automation solutions for mission-critical systems. At Samsung Electronics, led product roadmaps and feature development for Digital Convergence Solutions commercialization.

Innovation & Collaboration: At Microsoft, delivered customer-focused technical consultation with practical problem-solving. At Samsung SDS, contributed to billing solution development (early 'Samsung Pay' prototype).

Leadership: US Army - managed Army-wide database management system, supervised 15+ soldiers.

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer (in test)
positions.description:
AI-Powered Desktop Trading Platform Automation (Fidelity Trader+) - https://www.fidelity.com/trading/trading-platforms 
* Architected enterprise-grade performance testing framework for Fidelity Trader+ desktop platform, leveraging generative AI capabilities to design metadata-driven architecture that abstracts platform complexity and accelerates test development cycles by 300%

* Engineered intelligent cross-platform test orchestration system with YAML-based UI abstraction layer, enabling seamless test execution across Windows and macOS environments while maintaining single codebase - reducing maintenance overhead and ensuring consistent quality metrics across platforms

* Designed and implemented multi-workspace testing strategy with advanced workspace detection and intelligent routing mechanisms, enabling parallel performance validation of complex trading workflows across primary and secondary workspace configurations

* Delivered comprehensive observability pipeline integrating real-time telemetry collection, automated analytics, and intelligent reporting systems that provide actionable performance insights to stakeholders within minutes of test completion

* Transformed team productivity through AI-augmented knowledge transfer program, developing structured onboarding curriculum that reduced new engineer ramp-up time from 8 weeks to 2 weeks while maintaining code quality

* Pioneered LLM-integrated development workflows for test automation, establishing patterns and best practices for AI-assisted coding and debugging that became team standards

Mobile & Omnichannel Solutions
* Led cross-functional development for Fidelity's young investor mobile platform, establishing Customer Scenario Based Testing as company standard; built omnichannel SDK strategy (iOS/Android/Web) with metadata-driven framework enabling rapid team contribution

positions.title: Mobile App Designer
positions.description:
* Generated the idea & architecture for the unique music & dance app from scratch and successfully released to Google Play Store & iPhone AppStore
* Co-developed the entire app using Flutter & Firebase (Both Android & iOS) - 2 people project
* Continuous promotion, marketing, & technical maintenance of the App.
* HTTP://www.kpoprandomdances.com

positions.title: Software Quality & Automation Expert
positions.description:
* Built up the holistic strategic quality roadmap for America’s #1 music streaming platform under agile release life cycle (3 weeks), utilizing market-dominant mobile automation framework (Espresso/ XCTest)
* Refactored the automation legacy codebase, increasing the code reuse and accelerating Mobile A/B Test

positions.title: Automation Architect
positions.description:
Designed complex automation (API Test, WPF/Web UI test) framework for the company commercial customer solution and implemented its automation suites from scratch, using ES6 JavaScript APIs (Smartbear test-complete)

Awarded Biggest Pivot Award (1st Place)- The idea or hack that had to pivot from the original idea the most (Company 'Hackathon' competition event). (Power-solution config management system using NodeJS Modbus & Python robot f/w)

positions.title: Sr. SDET (Software Development Engineer in Test) & Tech Lead
positions.description:
Enhanced company-wide Automation Framework Architecture, increasing code-reuse, scale-out, and maintenance.
 
	Designed architecture for data-driven automation framework model and developed automation scenarios (Smart Bear Test Complete), reducing manual test efforts(1,150%) and cost ($412,000 a year)

  Implemented restful APIs which can communicate between Linux and Windows, providing optimized regression automation test suites targeting critical field issues

	Maintained over 1,000 automation test cases and unit test applicable to daily build for the diverse windows application & web solution.

	Prioritized legacy casino APIs by statistical analysis and re-organized the framework modules in Object Oriented Methodologies.

	Improved embedded simulation testing tool, replacing physical casino game machine system.
 
        Developed CI/CD using Jenkins, adding new automated test cases automatically and running the automatic regression run nightly.

	Demonstrated global leadership in test automation framework, practice, training, and mentorship (external: regional office in India, offshore contractors, Junior SDETs, QAs, Compliance engineers).

      Developed and promoted JIT(Just In Time) keyword driven test approach, encapsulating the robust script based automation framework, inspired manual QAs to participate in automation implementation throughout global QA teams

         Received "CTO Award" as a winner from June 2016 Global Tech Fair, showing advanced technologies and merits: Automation using DDT(Data Driven Test) approach in Class II Game.

          Gained multiple "Winning Ways" awards: Core company value: "Deliver, Unite, Develop" for the various achievements: Built meaningful varied relationships across the organization as well as developed KT(Knowledge Transfer) to relevant stakeholders who need training.

	Being responsible for a technical interview for hiring new automation engineers and QAs as a company hiring committee member.

positions.title: Sr. Software Engineer / Digital Solution Incubation R&D
positions.description:
Incubated primitive Digital Convergence Sol - IoT. - Home/Hotel/Office/City automation (compatible to Google Home), smart TV, camera, and Health sol., delivering to the commercial business divisions.

Jointly created and coordinated new features for multiple product roadmaps with marketing, R&D, and field engineering to address customer demands for a reliable, high-quality home, office, and hotel network solutions(Windows CE Embedded Solution Architecture and Protocol)

Solicited customer feedback and standardized Samsung’s software testing simulation model, Customer Scenario Based Test using Test Quest Pro Platform, achieving 50% better quality score with 60% higher reliability in 2008; received "Superior Engineer for Excellent Customer Satisfaction" award.

Teamed with American division to create appropriate Windows API (Application Programming Interface) for diverse situations within multiple 3rd party vendors; responsible for ensuring high-quality testing and customization of APIs for American distribution.

Built up the KM(Knowledge Management) Systems for ‘customer dissatisfaction cases’ database and delivered the most critical market-oriented trouble issue to the field engineers and sales forces. Reduced outsourcing costs by 30%, and accelerated the speed to market.

Designed the company’s first supply of tailored Samsung home network solutions to Chinese customers in 2007; adopted as the company-wide exemplary model for the future Chinese market.

Created the automated solution for IBM Rational Based  SQMS (Software Quality Management System), which was selected as Samsung’s company-wide Superior Software Innovative Model.  

Converted the manual software test case utilized in SQMS to 50% automation while lowering the customer dissatisfaction reports by 50%, resulting in lower outsourcing costs and increased acceleration to the market.

positions.title: SDET / Windows Server Product R&D
positions.description:
Program management and strategic decisions regarding the products/development - SQL Server Business Intelligence, Data Warehouse, CMS (Contents Management Server) with MS ASP.NET FOR Visual C# & ADO.NET technology.

Designed Global Samsung Business Network architecture for optimal network infrastructure and software tuning of MS EAI & ERP (Exchange Server, BizTalk Server) for deploying services to Samsung’s 6 continents offices.

Provided database tuning and analytical services product (Data Mining) solution to local partners (Samsung Insurance and ETS TOEIC Services); successfully optimized the large scale traffic and database for the deployment and customization for market needs.

Upgraded top IT companies’ software architecture (Samsung Electronics, SK Telecom) and initiated first company-wide migration of the legacy system to world-wide Microsoft technology models, standardizing the prototype for the next subsidiary migration. 

Coordinated with Asia Pacific managers, US Headquarters, as well as Business and Marketing Team, and led Korean-optimized MS Reporting Services (a solution for printing diverse types of documents) which was selected as an Asian model. 

Planned and directly instructed technical training sessions as an MS technology evangelizer for non-technical stakeholders - marketing team, CSS (Customer Service Support Team), C-Tec instructors (Microsoft Official Instructors) and partner developers, every 6 months.

positions.title: Software Developer / Online Solution Team
positions.description:
Developed and commercialized the industry’s first Internet Payment Gateway to be embedded with a public key infrastructure 128-bit encrypted module with enhanced security.(Credit card, Mobile payment) - Primitive version of SamsungPay

Provided to B2B corporations (Lycos Korea, etc.) and commercialized Korea’s first solution to be customizable through API of the virtual bank account system (Hana Bank, Woori Bank) Payment Solution Solution under various platforms (NT, Unix, Linux) and languages (PHP-MySql-Apache, Unix C, JSP).

Provided the urgent troubleshooting for army based software solutions to US Army soldiers in FTX(Field Training Exercise) in order to cope with the possible war.

Served as DBA for an army-wide DB management sys. : Whole 8th US Army officers & enlisted soldiers.

An innovated time-saving, robust army-wide casualty management system that automated database update functions, enabling nationwide DB for US armed forces in Korea to maintain the up-to-date personnel database and process-exception information to be automatically populated.

Taught the Korean language and culture for Korean-American children as well as diverse Korean culture lovers in the Greater Nashville Area every weekend
